label: R17-QUARTUS-PHYSICAL
title: Run a fresh A10 physical probe for the R17 timing batch
dependency_gate: Local manifest/scripts may be prepared now. No remote access, file sync, Quartus process, or probe creation is allowed until the integrator confirms the exact 738cc14 candidate completed the full registered L0-L2 union, including the corrected NEON fetch-fault semantic guard.
physical_rtl_equivalence: T-015 changes only Makefile, sim/difftest, task and handoff/evidence files; formal/platform RTL and FPGA project inputs are byte-identical to 0166ede.
scope: From the exact clean source SHA, create a new isolated 52-entry source/project manifest and fresh remote Quartus database; rebuild the Quartus-21.4-only fp_scalar compatibility copy by removing exactly four default port values; run guarded synthesis, fitter and signoff STA serially; extract full setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse, DDR/metastability, sys_clk_50 Fmax/top-50 and directional queries for the removed and replacement cones.
writes: the single fresh remote probe directory declared above
forbidden_regions: T-008 or any existing remote Quartus database
quartus_pgm, JTAG/Flash writes, programming, power-on or board test

manifest.closure: remote count=52, missing=0, extra=0, bad=0 before synthesis
manifest.compatibility_copy: Generate from current fp_scalar source; remove only iter_kill, iter_pause, divider kill and divider pause default values; record formal hash, patched hash and exact diff. Never reuse the T-008 patched blob.

stages: custom setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse, DDR/metastability and EMIF directional reports
sys_clk_50 setup top-50 plus directional old/new cone queries
directional_acceptance: old pp_pre to pack_mid direct path returns 0 paths
exmem_valid, memwb_wb_rd and exmem_wb_rd to fp_exec.acc/acc_flags each return 0 paths
report and cluster pp_pre-to-pack_pre, pack_pre-to-pack_mid, pack_mid-to-slot_result, slot_result-to-acc and any new top-N cones

resource.local: preparation only; no heavy local work in parallel with T-013
resource.remote: one Quartus process; MaxRunSeconds=43200 per stage; MinFreeMb=16384; pre/post EDA_COUNT=0; do not stop jtagserver or non-EDA processes
resource.safety: guard breach, nonzero stage exit, or manifest mismatch stops the flow and forbids the next stage

acceptance: The fresh probe is bound to the exact source/project manifest; synthesis and fitter exit zero within resource gates; signoff and all directional/top-50 evidence are complete and hashed. Timing improvement is reported from measured STA only. Timing closure requires all setup/hold/DDR/metastability gates, but a negative setup result is an honest physical result and triggers the next RTL timing batch rather than assembler or board actions.

review.summary: Fresh synthesis/fitter/STA evidence is valid and improved Fmax/setup/TNS, but sys_clk_50 setup remains negative and six core-control-to-acc/flags directional queries remain nonzero. Continue with R18; no assembler or board release.

board_policy: No Quartus assembler, SOF/JIC/RBF/POF/JBC/SVF/JAM, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
